replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I'm sorry to say but your map has been denied from the Avicus Network.

Here are the reasons why:
No Cover for a Frenzy map
Add some more space for PvP
Map looks a bit confusing from images
Add more block types and make it not only white but different variations.

You may submit your map again once you fix it.
